description:
Want to restore the planet’s ecosystems and see your impact in monthly videos? The first 150 people to join Planet Wild with my code DAN8 will get the first month for free at https://planetwild.com/r/daninblue/join 

If you want to get to know them better first, check out their latest project supporting Indigenous communities to protect the Amazon rainforest from illegal logging https://planetwild.com/r/daninblue/m29 

ᯡ Congrats on winning the race! Across the animal kingdom, sperm varies wildly by size, shape, and competitiveness, leading to very strange sperm adaptations. But the evolution of these tiny warriors also drives the evolution of animals as a whole, including humans.

[CLOSED CAPTIONS ARE AVAILABLE ON THIS VIDEO]
